title: $8 Billion Vanished From a Crypto Exchange — Where Did It Go? #Shorts
description:
A crypto exchange was holding billions of its customers' dollars. Then about eight billion of it went missing.

FTX was one of the biggest crypto exchanges in the world, and its founder was its most trusted face. But hidden in the code was a secret exception: a private trading firm could pull customer deposits almost without limit.

When everyone asked for their money back, it wasn't there. In 2023, a jury found the founder guilty in one of the largest frauds in U.S. history. Even in crypto, spending customers' money is theft.

Watch the full story on the channel.

#Shorts #FTX #CryptoCollapse #Fraud #Crypto #FinancialCrime #Documentary
